about_the_game:
Cats, Dogs, and… the Grim Reaper

The struggle of a cat and a dog to return from death begins now. Guard your home with traps, unleash chaos in your rival’s, and remember to fix up your own house before time runs out. Sharpen your mind, trust your speed, and put those paws to work to snatch the second chance the Grim  Reaper offers in this 1v1 arena action-strategy.

Two neighbors—a cat and a dog—have hated each other for years while living on the same street. One day, as they’re fighting in the yard, lightning “accidentally” strikes them both and their lives end… and they find themselves before the Grim Reaper! But this isn’t the end—Azrael gives them one last chance:

“Make your owner happy by sunset. The winner lives. The loser will be forgotten forever.”

Shape Your Tactics, Tame the Chaos!

Defend your home with traps, turn your rival’s house upside down, or focus on repairing your own. What you do and when you do it is entirely your decision.

Lay traps in your own house and make your enemy’s job harder. With smartly placed traps and creative defenses make it harder to target your stuff and force your rival to waste precious time.

With tools and paws, create absolute mayhem. Shatter glasses, topple the TV, smear mud across the floors—make the owner lose their mind! But beware: your rival’s plotting the same for you. plotting the same for you.

Dash back and fix every mess! Race the clock to keep your place clean and tidy so you can make your owner happy.   When your owner returns, make sure you’re the one smiling!

When the timer hits zero, whoever’s owner is angry goes to their appointment with the Grim Reaper.This is a battle of intellect, speed, and strategy. You may be adorable, but to win you’ll have to be ruthless!

  • One-of-a-Kind Competition: A comedic cocktail of strategy, speed, and sabotage.

  • Smashable, Dynamic World: Wreck every corner of the house. Smash cups like a cat, or decorate the floor with muddy pawprints like a dog.

  • Multiple Tactics and Tools: Use different traps to outsmart your rival in a new way every time.

  • Charming but Lethal!: Cats and dogs have never been this adorable—and this merciless.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit / Windows 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750-Ti / AMD RX 550, 2GB VRam
  • DirectX: Version 11
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 64-bit / Windows 11, 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 7500K / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580, 4GB VRam / Intel Arc A380
  • DirectX: Version 11
